terra.problem: The line about making the trip make sense with a tomb is an unclear joke; its logic does not click.
The joke about having a lot of tents makes the Tent of Meeting, a holy thing, part of the joke.
The passage does not describe the route or say the trip was short and had no detours.
Saying they came to seek the LORD adds a reason for their journey. The passage says they went because the Tent of Meeting was there, and that they inquired of Him there.
The passage says they inquired of the LORD there in Gibeon; it does not specify that they did so at the altar.
A whole night's worth of possibilities adds a duration the text does not give.
“Wrong thing” describes the baker's answer as wrong, which Papa Dorin must not do.
Saying the whole prayer is aimed at the people, not at Solomon himself, overstates the text. His prayer also speaks of God's devotion to David, Solomon's kingship, and God's promise to David.
